summary: Victory Capital Holdings filed an 8-K on July 13, 2026, disclosing a press release with month-end and quarterly assets under management as of June 30, 2026. Total AUM was $342.4 billion, with net long-term inflows of $4.2 billion in Q2. The filing includes no M&A, restructuring, activist, or other special-situation event; it is a routine periodic AUM update and a scheduled earnings conference call notice. Because this is a standard current report of operating metrics with no transactional or corporate action content, it does not qualify as a special situation.
